decisions.reason: The quote describes the untreated eye with 'progressively declining function' in a sheep with CLN5 disease. The surrounding abstract establishes that affected sheep have 'a naturally occurring CLN5 form of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL)' and the untreated eye shows progressive decline. Visual decline (progressively declining function) is a phenotype of CLN5 disease in this context.

The quote describes the untreated eye with 'severe atrophy' in a sheep with CLN5 disease. The surrounding abstract establishes that affected sheep have 'a naturally occurring CLN5 form of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL)'. Retinal atrophy (severe atrophy of the retina) is a phenotype of CLN5 disease in this context.

The quote directly demonstrates a therapeutic effect of AAV9.CLN5 gene therapy on CLN5 disease. The treated eye maintained 'Retinal structure and function' up to 15 months after treatment, while the untreated control eye showed 'progressively declining function and severe atrophy'. This comparison clearly establishes that the AAV9.CLN5 treatment prevented the disease progression observed in the untreated eye, demonstrating therapeutic effect against CLN5 disease.
